statement: A replica drops its own uncommitted proposal when a certified frame commits at that height. The Quint cell holds the Right side's rollback on a collision: its in-flight txs go back to the queue and the peer's frame applies (right-drops-inflight-on-collision); the Left side keeps its own frame (R-A1).
